topic: Get 3 new Google reviews this week: who to ask and how
caption:
Most owners wait for reviews to show up on their own.
They don't.
Pick three people you helped this week. Text them. Send the direct Google review link so there's zero friction. Do it today, not Friday.
Want a checklist like this for your whole online presence? DM us REVIEWS.
